key_results: Strong correlation between Al electrode thickness, grain size, and TLS density; two-thirds reduction in TLS via fabrication parameter change; analyzed 6000 Al/AlOx/Al JJs with 600+ TEM images
comments: Data-driven approach successfully links fabrication→microstructure→TLS; methodology extensible to other quantum device architectures.

model_io.model: Al/AlOx/Al Josephson junctions with variable fabrication

hypotheses.hypothesis: Al grain size and electrode thickness govern TLS density in JJs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via statistical correlation across 6000 devices; two-thirds reduction achieved

title: Gate-induced layer sliding drives non-volatile switching of magnetism in tetralayer graphene
task: Manipulate magnetic phase via gate-induced layer sliding in tetralayer graphene
key_results: Bistable switching between Bernal (non-magnetic) and rhombohedral-Bernal mixed (ferromagnetic) states; anomalous Hall effect emerges; sign reversal under opposite displacement fields suggests domain-boundary origin
comments: Non-volatile magnetic switching via structural phase transition is novel; Hall-signal reversal implies domain boundaries mediate magnetism.

model_io.model: Marginally twisted double-bilayer graphene with gate control

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gate-induced Bernal↔rhombohedral sliding drives non-volatile magnetic switching
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ferromagnetism emerges in rhombohedral-Bernal mixed phase

title: Parity-dependent coupling of molecular spin chains to a superconductor
task: Probe parity-dependent coupling of molecular Haldane chains to superconductors
key_results: Odd-length chains host YSR states with S=1 ground state; even-length chains form S=0 ground state decoupled from superconductor; length-tunable edge-spin coupling demonstrated
comments: Fractionalization of edge states survives superconducting proximity despite open questions about topological protection mechanisms.

model_io.model: Molecular Haldane chains (triangulene units) on proximitized Au(111)/Nb(110)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fractional edge spins of Haldane chains couple differently to superconductors based on chain parity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via scanning tunneling spectroscopy; YSR states appear only for odd-length chains

title: Correction of the transient thermal analysis model for the solar extreme ultraviolet imager based on in-orbit data
task: Correct transient thermal finite-element models for satellite systems using surrogate models and stochastic optimization
key_results: Latin Hypercube sampling + surrogate MLP model + Animated Oat/StarFish optimization reduced maximum temperature deviation by 6.64 °C at β=57.4° and 3.67 °C at β=88.6°; surrogate model enables rapid correction iterations
comments: Multi-objective optimization balances multiple operating conditions; validated across two solar beta angles; generalizable to diverse satellite thermal designs.

model_io.model: Transient FEM thermal model with parameter sensitivity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Surrogate model + stochastic optimization efficiently corrects transient thermal FEM
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 6.64 °C maximum deviation reduction at β=57.4°

title: Dissociative electron attachment dynamics in pulsed Cl2 plasma process: characteristic pulse-OFF time on chamber diameter
task: Study dissociative electron attachment and chamber-size effects on pulsed Cl₂ plasma for semiconductor etching
key_results: Small-diameter chamber exhibits 2× higher radial electron diffusion loss; optimal pulse-OFF times differ: 200 μs for large (1.8 nm/min etch rate) vs 100 μs for small (5.5 nm/min); diffusion rates ∼1.4×10⁴ and ∼2.9×10³ s⁻¹
comments: Chamber geometry strongly governs transient plasma behavior and ion-ion plasma formation timescale; results provide practical guidance for pulsed-plasma scaling.

model_io.model: Pulsed Cl₂ plasma discharge with chamber size variation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chamber size governs optimal pulse-OFF time for ion-ion plasma formation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; small chamber requires 100 μs vs large chamber 200 μs for peak etch rate

title: Quantum eddy current wall thickness tomography using nitrogen-vacancy vector magnetometry for onshore crude oil pipeline integrity assessment
task: Enable pipeline integrity assessment via quantum eddy current wall-thickness tomography using NV magnetometry
key_results: NV vector magnetometry + machine-learning tomography achieves 61% detection accuracy for 1 μm nominal wall perturbation; coherence time 70.5 μs under 25 nT noise; 93.5% overall detection vs 65.6% for MFL; ultrasonic calibration confirms reconstruction agreement
comments: Three-phase orthogonal excitation reduces directional blind spots; laser-written NV arrays enable sensor integration; practical deployment challenges remain.

model_io.model: NV-magnetometry quantum eddy current tomography

hypotheses.hypothesis: NV-based quantum sensing achieves higher detection sensitivity than classical MFL for pipeline defects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 93.5% detection rate vs 65.6% for MFL under tested conditions

title: Vibration amplification mechanism and theoretical mitigation strategy for feedwater flow meter brackets in nuclear power plants
task: Mitigate low-frequency vibration amplification in feedwater flow meter brackets
key_results: 10–50 Hz band contributes 56.1% of mean-square acceleration; retrofit reduced overall acceleration by 18.4–26.4 dB over 10 Hz–8 kHz; met NB/T 25,081–2018 safety criterion
comments: Cantilever-beam model and isolation optimization validated by FEM, lab tests, and field measurements; practical retrofit route for lightweight brackets on flexible platforms.

model_io.model: Feedwater flow meter bracket on steel grating platform

hypotheses.hypothesis: Local reinforcement + isolation design reduces 10–50 Hz contribution in bracket vibration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 18.4–26.4 dB reduction achieved across instrumentation panels

title: A differentiable multi-physics learning model for robust single-image dehazing under complex atmospheric conditions
task: Restore single-image visibility under complex atmospheric conditions via differentiable multi-physics learning
key_results: Framework integrates scattering, turbulence-induced blur, and spectral attenuation; RESIDE-SOTS benchmark: PSNR/SSIM = 27.3/0.94 (indoor), 30.2/0.94 (outdoor); robust to noise perturbations and severe illumination variations
comments: Differentiable physics-inspired constraints improve consistency; iterative regularization stabilizes reconstruction without error propagation.

model_io.model: Multi-physics image formation model with turbulence and spectral effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint modeling of scattering, turbulence, and spectral effects improves dehazing robustness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; competitive performance with enhanced robustness to noise and illumination variations

title: Experimental study of the effects of DCA airfoil geometric parameters on the aerodynamic performance at low reynolds numbers flows
task: Characterize DCA airfoil aerodynamic performance at low Reynolds numbers
key_results: Higher camber enhances lift and delays stall; dominant frequency 58–64 Hz (below vortex shedding); thinner airfoils generate higher lift at low angles; leading/trailing edge radii have minor effects
comments: Coupled aerodynamic mechanisms rather than simple vortex shedding; DCA airfoils promising for wind turbine and low-speed vehicle applications despite traditional transonic design focus.

model_io.model: DCA airfoil in low-speed wind tunnel

hypotheses.hypothesis: Camber angle substantially affects stall behavior and pressure distribution in low-Reynolds flow
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; increased camber delays stall and enhances suction peaks

title: Observation of long-lived nitrogen afterglow following low-pressure theta-pinch discharges
task: Investigate long-lived nitrogen afterglow following low-pressure theta-pinch discharge
key_results: Yellow-green afterglow persists ~18 s in pure N₂ at 1.44 Pa; N₂ first positive system (B³Πg→A³Σu⁺) identified; characteristic decay time decreases from 5.86 s to 3.04 s with 21% O₂
comments: Lewis-Rayleigh-type afterglow confirmed; low-pressure results cannot extrapolate to atmospheric conditions (N atom lifetime ~2.1 ms in air).

model_io.model: Low-pressure theta-pinch discharge in N₂/O₂

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nitrogen recombination produces long-lived afterglow via metastable excited states
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; v'=12,11 vibrational populations dominate; oxygen quenches decay

title: A strain-aware electromechanical framework for III-nitride axial nanowire heterostructures toward an energy-efficient high-frequency tunnel FET
task: Design strain-aware polarization-engineered III-nitride nanowire tunnel FET for high-frequency operation
key_results: InN/In₀.₆₅Ga₀.₃₅N/InN structure achieves subthreshold swing 11.3 mV/dec, cutoff frequencies 268–76 GHz, transconductance 723–997 μS/μm across 225–400 K; Ka/V/W-band operation demonstrated
comments: Coupled WKB-FEM framework balances mechanical strain retention with tunneling optimization; zero-bias rectification via polarization-induced fields enables millimeter-wave detection.

model_io.model: Polarization-engineered III-nitride axial nanowire TFET

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strain-aware polarization control enables coherent tunneling across relaxed heterostructures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; InN/InGaN/InN achieves steep switching under both coherent and relaxed strain

title: Turbulent mixing by non-breaking surface waves in the ocean: theory, observation and modeling
task: Establish theoretical foundation for turbulent mixing driven by non-breaking ocean surface waves
key_results: Non-breaking waves enhance turbulence dissipation and mixing to depth ~horizontal wavelength; direct wave-to-turbulence energy transfer without Stokes drift; deeper summer mixed layers and cooler SSTs in coupled models
comments: Resolves persistent model bias of too-shallow mixed layers and hot SSTs; mixing depth comparable to mixed-layer depth—major improvement over wave-breaking-only mechanisms.

model_io.model: Non-breaking surface wave turbulence interaction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-breaking waves enhance background turbulence to depths comparable to wavelength
hypotheses.result: Confirmed theoretically and validated against laboratory/field observations

title: An accurate Lanczos method for the matrix product state representation
task: Enhance Lanczos convergence for matrix product state eigenstate finding
key_results: Thick-block Lanczos method achieves optimal accuracy for given bond dimension; demonstrates scalability to 50-site Fermi-Hubbard and 120-site Heisenberg models
comments: Eliminates high-error plateau endemic to naive MPS-Lanczos; shift-and-invert enables direct excited-state targeting.

model_io.model: Matrix product state Lanczos diagonalization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thick-block modification of Lanczos overcomes MPS bond-truncation accuracy degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on benchmark models; achieves optimal accuracy for given bond dimension

title: Liouvillian exceptional-point-induced phase transition in a single Kerr-cat qubit
task: Investigate Liouvillian exceptional-point-induced phase transitions in Kerr-cat qubits
key_results: Non-Hermitian phase transition observed at LEP with sudden transition from underdamped oscillations to overdamped relaxations; Wigner negativity confirms genuine quantum nonclassicality
comments: Numerical simulations only; experimental realization of LEP-driven criticality in CV systems remains to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: Driven-dissipative Kerr-cat qubit

hypotheses.hypothesis: LEPs induce genuine non-Hermitian phase transitions in CV systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via Wigner function interference fringes and dynamical pattern changes

title: Alternative splicing fine-tunes modular protein interfaces to control protein localization
task: Determine how alternative splicing reorganizes protein interactions and cellular localization
key_results: 38% of tested isoform pairs alter protein localization; microexons account for substantial proportion despite being <5 amino acids; 4-aa microexon in sorting nexin 2 drives localization changes via charged residue repositioning
comments: The systematic high-content imaging screen is rigorous, though the mechanistic basis of localization changes remains incompletely characterized for most isoforms.

model_io.model: High-content imaging screen of exon-isoform pairs
Sorting nexin 2 variants with/without 4-aa microexon

hypotheses.hypothesis: Longer exons primarily reshape local interaction patterns while microexons fine-tune key interfaces
hypotheses.result: True; tissue-regulated longer exons show preferential effects on local patterns; microexons target interface-linking regions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Microexons alter protein localization through repositioning of charged residues and modulation of local electrostatic environments
hypotheses.result: True for sorting nexin 2 microexon; residue insertion rather than side-chain chemistry drives the effect

title: Genetic modulation of NAD(P)H homeostasis reveals distinct redox-coupled metabolic vulnerabilities
task: Dissect NAD(P)H redox coupling in mitochondrial dysfunction and ageing
key_results: SaNADK restores reductive carboxylation and reverses proliferation arrest in primary fibroblasts; hepatic SaNADK partially alleviates inflammatory and metabolic dysregulation signatures in aged mice
comments: The use of xenotopic redox tools (EcSTH, SaNADK) is creative, though translational applicability of bacterial enzymes in mammalian systems remains to be established.

model_io.model: Primary human fibroblasts with mitochondrial respiratory chain inhibition
EcSTH-expressing primary human fibroblasts and HeLa cells
SaNADK-expressing primary fibroblasts
Aged male mice with hepatic SaNADK

hypotheses.hypothesis: NADH/NAD+ normalization alone rescues proliferation in both primary fibroblasts and HeLa cells
hypotheses.result: False; rescue occurs only in HeLa cells; primary fibroblasts require NADPH restoration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Primary fibroblasts depend on NADPH-driven reductive carboxylation more than HeLa cells
hypotheses.result: True, confirmed by stable isotope tracing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Expanding the NADP(H) pool via SaNADK reverses proliferation arrest and senescence in primary fibroblasts
hypotheses.result: True; SaNADK restores reductive carboxylation, pyrimidine biosynthesis, and proliferative capacity
